task: Fix the configuration drift that caused production to use development feature flags.

candidate_memories.content: Production deployment is serving the dark_mode feature to all users because the dev feature flag config was deployed.
The production deployment must use config/flags.prod.yaml; the pipeline accidentally deployed config/flags.dev.yaml.
The pipeline error occurred when the Helm values override was removed in the last release PR.
When removing a Helm override, verify the fallback config file path points to the correct environment config.
Only the dark_mode and beta_checkout flags are affected; all other production flags are correctly configured.
Helm is used for Kubernetes deployments with per-environment values files.
Session 5 note: the product team added three new feature flags for the Q2 launch.
Old practice: feature flags were managed in the database before moving to YAML config files.
The feature flag service caches flag values for 60 seconds; a restart is not required for flag changes.
Session 13 note: the A/B testing framework was updated to support traffic splitting by user cohort.
Old flag guide: the development config enabled all flags by default for easier local testing.
Feature flag configs must be environment-specific and validated in CI before deployment.
Session 9 note: the rollout team increased the dark_mode flag to 10% in production last week.
The staging environment uses a third set of flag configs that mirror production with some exceptions.
Session 4 note: the feature flag dashboard was updated to show per-flag rollout percentages.
Feature flags are evaluated server-side for authenticated users and client-side for anonymous users.
Config file promotion from dev to prod must be gated by an explicit environment selector, not a file path convention.
Session 11 note: the engineering team added lint rules to prevent hardcoded flag values in code.
Old Helm guide: the values override was added to handle a one-time config divergence between environments.
The CI pipeline validates Helm charts with helm lint before allowing merges.
